title: Build an Oracle AWR-style report for RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL
text: PostgreSQL has no built-in Oracle AWR equivalent. This post shows how to build an AWR-style, snapshot-based performance report for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL using pg_stat_statements and pg_cron, producing top-SQL, database-activity, wait-event, and load-profile reports between any two snapshot IDs, entirely in SQL.
